question: Should Rhamnus frangula be recommended for: short-term treatment of occasional constipation?

records.notes: EU herbal monograph on Rhamnus frangula bark grants well-established-use status as a stimulant laxative for short-term treatment of occasional constipation, standardised to hydroxyanthracene glycosides (as glucofrangulin A), max 30 mg/day.
records.source_title: Community herbal monograph on Rhamnus frangula L., cortex
